name: Shape of Dreams: Prologue
detailed_description:
Notice: Updates for the Prologue have been discontinued

🎉 With an incredible 500,000 Travelers journeying through The Rapids, our Prologue beta test has successfully concluded. We sincerely thank you for joining us on our quest to create a better game!

Updates and support for the Prologue version have been discontinued.

However, all content that was added to the Prologue has been improved based on community feedback and updated identically in the Demo. Your saves will also transfer, so you can continue your journey through The Rapids without losing any progress. Continue your adventure in the Demo!


About the Game

《Shape of Dreams: Prologue》is a free prologue version of 《Shape of Dreams》, a game that fuses MOBA-style combat with action roguelike elements.

The Rapids: The Realm Between Dreams and Reality

One day, the boundary between the dream world and reality collapsed, allowing passage to an intermediate realm called "The Rapids" through dimensional rifts. With rumors of unknown origin claiming that reaching the end of the dream world grants any wish, heroes step into this mysterious realm, each with their own reasons.

Memory Editing

You can edit your memories to create your own unique character. Utilize memories from your past to defeat enemies in combat. Attach mysterious gems called Essences to your memories to grant special effects and create powerful synergies.

A ranged carry with ridiculously powerful melee attacks? A self-destructing mage? Everything is possible!

Uncover the Secrets of The Rapids

The dream world is ever-changing. Procedurally generated worlds filled with dream inhabitants, quests, various events, and hidden secrets await you. The diverse secrets within this world will provide a new experience with each run. Unlock over 200 collectible items along the way. But be careful, the Hunters are always watching you.

Challenge Yourself Endlessly

With difficulty options and a permanent upgrade system, you can enjoy everything Shape of Dreams has to offer even if you're not exceptionally skilled. Nevertheless, if you enjoy a challenge, merciless trials await you, including Lucid Dreams that let you bend the rules of The Rapids and powerful hidden bosses. Overcome these trials and prove yourself!

Diverse Characters and Playstyles

Confident in your mechanical skills? Then we recommend Mist, a fast and agile melee character! How about Vesper, a sturdy and powerful tank? Or perhaps you'd like to carry your friends as a ranged damage dealer?

Shape of Dreams features characters in various roles including ranged carries, bruisers, tanks, mages, and more. Find the character with a playstyle that perfectly suits you.

Solo or With Friends

Shape of Dreams offers a complete experience in single-player, but also supports co-op multiplayer for up to 4 players. Experience exceptional cooperative gameplay through rich interaction systems including healing, buffs, crowd control, and more!
